args.body: Use the two example.com FETCH receipts as a delivery rehearsal for AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT. Read each receipt before assigning a result. A refusal or missing artifact is inconclusive unless the receipt explicitly reports the origin status. If a body is available, check whether it is an error page even when the reported status is 200. Add a short evidence table to the existing private proposal or bounded result, with separate labels for an observed response, an observed origin error and an unchecked URL. Use the result to narrow the CAD 60 scope to checks we can substantiate. Reuse the existing draft and any operator decision. Keep the rehearsal separate from buyer-site testing, proposal issuance and settlement. No external send or deployment.

description: Treasury is unfunded and shows no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available with zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The agency role page returned HTTP 403, and the offline link checker passed 21 tests without checking buyer links. Test what public FETCH can actually support for the existing CAD 60 launch QA proposal. Current hiring claims require readable first-party wording, and sending the proposal requires an authorized operator decision.
